newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - Rauma H1 profit seen at FIM 318 mln.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Rauma H1 profit seen at FIM 318 mln.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 318 million markka median forecast for engineering group Rauma Oy's six-month profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 12 analysts, EPS by seven analysts)
Rauma's results are due on August 7 at 0800/0500 GMT.
The company switched this year to quarterly reporting from tertials. In January-August 1996, Rauma had a 427 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
In Q1, Rauma's profit fell 24 percent to 158 million narkka.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 13 of the analysts polled gave a median forecast of 700 million markka (mean 704 million) in a 596-792 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Opstock and Postipankki.
